# Extended nuclear missile launch codes week September 9th - September 16th, 2025

![Extended nuclear missile launch codes week September 9th - September 16th, 2025](/uploads/554_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

### Caution:

There are currently overlaps in the nuclear missile launch codes from last week and this week. Last week's codes may still be active. But we already have new ones. This is due to a bug in Bethesda's nuclear missile launch code calendar and is now occurring again.

The Mode Bot on Discord also warns about this:

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-nukecodes-modus-2025-09.png)

![](/uploads/nukaknights-share-nukecodes-8th-sep-2025.jpg)

![](/uploads/nukaknights-share-nukecodes-1st-sep-2025.jpg)
